description.p: KB-Remote is a tabbed remote-access workbench inspired by MobaXterm. It brings SSH/OpenSSH shells, SFTP file transfer and RDP remote desktops together in a single, keyboard-driven, NASA-style flight-ops interface.

ul.li: Tabbed SSH shells to Linux, Windows, BSD and macOS hosts with a real terminal emulator, agent/key/password auth, ProxyJump chaining and native terminal colors.
Embedded RDP sessions (FreeRDP) rendered inside the app, including on Wayland desktops.
Dual-pane SFTP browser with in-app text editing and secure upload.
Command palette, per-tab command line, in-terminal search, multi-host cluster runner, port scanner and SSH key utility.
Encrypted credential vault and TOFU host-key verification.
